channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jabari Parker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jabari Parker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Luke Walton on Jabari Parker
item.description:
Jason Jones:Luke Walton on Jabari Parker:

“Even though he’s been cleared to end his self isolation we still can’t have anybody who gets sick doing hard, physical work until a later date when you’re cleared again by doctors with how this virus attacks. He’s been reminded of that.”

Luke Walton on Jabari Parker, Jul 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Brooks on Portis:

“It's a great pickup. It's a great pickup. He loves to play. And the intel that I've got — talked to over coaches — is he's a gym rat. And Parker, he's an athletic guy. He's hard to guard. He's strong. He's a strong athlete.”

Scott Brooks on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis, Feb 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: John Paxson on Jabari Parker
item.description:
“What we saw in Jabari (Parker) is a guy who is 23-years-old and had talent. Sometimes the pieces don’t fit exactly right.”

John Paxson on Jabari Parker, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Jabari Parker
item.description:
“He understands. Jabari wants to make it about helping the team win. And that's what I've asked him to do.”

Jim Boylen on Jabari Parker, Dec 13, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Jabari Parker
item.description:
“I’ve talked to Jabari about what I’m thinking about what his role will be with the second group,”

Fred Hoiberg on Jabari Parker, Oct 11, 2018. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Robin Lopez on Jabari Parker
item.description:
KC Johnson:Robin Lopez, on Brook's dunk over Jabari Parker that is circulating on social media:

“I think it was just so surprising for everybody that Brook would make such an athletic play.”

Robin Lopez on Jabari Parker, Oct 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Fred Hoiberg on starting Jabari Parker at PF over Bobby Portis:

“We need to play Jabari at that position. And we love Bobby’s energy and the role that he’s played pretty much since he’s been here is that sixth man. So that was really the decision.”

Fred Hoiberg on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis, Sep 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Gar Forman on Jabari Parker
item.description:
There is no organization more familiar with the risk involved in banking on a star returning to form after a torn ACL -- after three consecutive seasons averaging better than 20 PPG before his injury, Rose never again averaged even 18 PPG in a Bulls uniform after it -- but the Bulls are willing to…

“Jabari is a 23-year-old player who is a natural fit with our young core,”

Gar Forman on Jabari Parker, Jul 16, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jon Horst on Jabari Parker
item.description:
The Milwaukee Bucks and Jabari Parker have reached an agreement for the team to rescind its qualifying offer, making Parker an unrestricted free agent.

“Jabari and I felt it was in the best interest of both he and the team to rescind our qualifying offer, making him an unrestricted free agent,”

Jon Horst on Jabari Parker, Jul 14, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jon Horst on Jabari Parker
item.description:
The Bucks weren't going to match a Bulls offer sheet, and the deal -- brokered with Parker's agent Mark Bartelstein -- allowed a good-faith gesture for Parker to sign a shorter deal with the Bulls.

“We really love Jabari and wanted to work with him on this, because we weren't going to match an offer sheet,”

Jon Horst on Jabari Parker, Jul 14, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Jabari Parker, Wesley Edens, Marc Lasry, Jamie Dinan, Jon Horst
item.description:
“Jabari and I express our sincere gratitude to Jon Horst and Bucks owners Marc Lasry, Wes Edens and Jamie Dinan for working side-by-side with us throughout the free agency period,”

Mark Bartelstein on Jabari Parker, Wesley Edens, Marc Lasry, Jamie Dinan, Jon Horst, Jul 14, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Jabari Parker
item.description:
Bucks All-Star forward Giannis Antetokounmpo said.

“We've got to do a better job too of finding him. He didn't have a great Game 1, but he's going to have a great Game 2 because that's what Jabari does.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Jabari Parker, Apr 17, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Joe Prunty on Jabari Parker
item.description:
Prunty on Jabari Parker playing both games of a back-to-back:

“It’s important for him, it’s important for us and we need him. It’s all hands on deck all the time, obviously with some of the guys that we do have out it creates opportunities for other people.”

Joe Prunty on Jabari Parker, Feb 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @Matt_Velazquez.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Jabari Parker
item.description:
“But that goes on with every team in every locker room at all times. Jason was tremendously supportive of Jabariin getting healthy and his rehab and encouraging him. I know Jabari greatly appreciated that. There was no rift between Jabari and Jason that had anything to do with this decision. This was just a decision that the Bucks organization made for whatever reasons they made it. It had nothing to do with Jabari, I can tell you that.”

Mark Bartelstein on Jabari Parker, Jan 23, 2018. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Jabari Parker
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Kidd on Jabari:

“He went the whole practice. He was Jabari; he was great. The big thing is he made it through the whole practice today and we'll see how he feels tomorrow.”

Jason Kidd on Jabari Parker, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
John Hammond:

“We're trying to build around some kind of consistenty with the nucleus of Michael Carter-Williams, Khris Middleton, Jabari Parker, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Greg Monroe and John Henson. Those six guys are the young core that we look and say that's kinda the future of this organization,and that's not discounting anyone else. Other players have to step and become a part of that group with us. But those guys are the group we hope we can build some kind of continuity with.”

John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aug 21, 2015. Source: Brew Hoop.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Jabari Parker
item.description:
Another Hall of Fame in-waiting inductee, Bucks coach Jason Kidd, said Parker’s exquisite all-around game is somewhat similar to that of James.

“When you look at Jabari, he does a lot of special things,”

Jason Kidd on Jabari Parker, Dec 27, 2014. Source: Racine Journal-Times.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Jabari Parker
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Kidd on Jabari:

“I thought he was doing everything as a rookie, being able to play both ends and help the team win... It's sad that a good kid like this who is doing all the right things and an injury like that takes him out for the season.”

Jason Kidd on Jabari Parker, Dec 17, 2014. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Andrew Wiggins, Jabari Parker
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:LaVine on Jabari:

“I know Andrew's been wanting to go at him cuz he's the No. 2 pick but I'm the 13 pick so I want to go at him too”

Zach LaVine on Andrew Wiggins, Jabari Parker, Nov 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @APkrawczynski.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jabari Parker, Andrew Wiggins, Joel Embiid
item.description:
“ButI’m not sure that there are those 20-to-25-point-a-game guys. Jabari averaged 19 points a game in the ACC, so he seems to be the most prepared to do that.(Joel) Embiid’s a rim protector. Wiggins is one of the freakiest athletes that’s come along, and he scored 16 or 17 a game in a tough conference. That’s probably why everyone’s talking about them at the top of the list, because they bring that scoring ability and that scoring potential to the table.”

Danny Ainge on Jabari Parker, Andrew Wiggins, Joel Embiid, May 17, 2014. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jabari Parker, Andrew Wiggins, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony:

“I'm a big Jabari fan, but it also depends on who has the pick at the No. 1 spot. But as far as being ready-ready, I think Jabari is ready. I think the big kid from Kansas [Joel Embiid] has some upside and [Kansas' Andrew] Wiggins has some potential. But as far as being ready to come in and step right in and kind of make an impact, I'd have to go with Jabari, too, especially because of the way he plays. He can play multiple positions. He can put the ball on the floor. He can score. He is in that Duke system, so he has some savvy with him.”

Carmelo Anthony on Jabari Parker, Andrew Wiggins, Joel Embiid, Mar 17, 2014. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
